candidates.reason: The candidate predates the usable Sandbox entitlement, PAYG transition, hosted CLI, complete OpenAPI, dedicated beta site policy, and autopilot operations contract.
The staged public-beta checksum manifest contained absolute workstation paths and was not portable to the deployment host.
The release fuzz runner placed its immutable source below the mutable Cargo workspace, so every required fuzz target failed before execution.
The signed TypeScript SDK tarball omitted its compiled ESM, CommonJS, and declaration files and could not be imported after installation.

The exact dark deployment exposed an upgrade defect in migration 0006: an existing worker with nonzero free scratch was checked against a newly defaulted total capacity of zero, so the API correctly failed closed before serving traffic.

The transactional dark-route drill exposed a host compatibility defect: Caddyfile syntax was validated without the required caddyfile adapter. The switch automatically restored containment before exposing the beta route.

Exact-candidate load preparation showed that re-registering an existing AIR verified the new local proof but retained the prior release identity in beta_air_packages, while upload and job admission did not reject stale AIR identities.
